items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ah, yes, my aunt – my Aunt Ida Mae, who is really the only sister still living.

ctx.x: Did you have a lot of family here in the area?

Ah, yes, my aunt – my Aunt Ida Mae, who is really the only sister still living. She’s the matriarch, as a matter of fact, at the moment. I have a lot of cousins that are here right now, even. My mother had what? – two sisters here in Indianapolis: Ida Mae, who is the matriarch – still living – and Ruth, who passed away a number of years ago. The other sisters lived elsewhere. Leona lived in Chicago and passed away in Chicago. Four brothers, all living elsewhere other than in Indianapolis. As my best recollection,…
And your father didn’t have any family here in Indianapolis?
